## Off-screen path

What happens if the player never meets this character? Describe the default resolution and
how the player might learn of it later (rumour, letter, changed state).

## Knowledge plan

## Author checklist

- [ ] Premise is personal, not a quest summary.
- [ ] Three beats, two acts.
- [ ] One resolution and one failure reachable.
- [ ] One path independent of the player.
- [ ] Successor defined if mortality applies.
- [ ] Knowledge path authored.
- [ ] Scenarios cover resolution and failure.
- [ ] Provenance recorded.
